messages:
Samira Patel: Quick follow-up on the postmortem from 2026-03-22. I spun up the action tickets and sketched ownership/timelines. Need confirmations so we can close the loop and add to the weekly remediation review.
Jared Kim: I took RWD-3421 (cache eviction fix) — owner: Jared. ETA: 2 weeks, working with infra. I'll add a subtask for load tests.
Priya Narang: I'll own RWD-3422 (add circuit-breaker + alerting). ETA: 1 week. Will coordinate with QA. @Theo Martinez can you help with the test harness?
Theo Martinez: Yep, will pair on the harness. Can add an automated regression job for RWD-3421 in ~3 days.
Marta SRE: Ops items consolidated into RWD-3423 (deploy checklist + rollback playbook). Oncall will run an initial canary after staging pass.
Samira Patel: Proposed RACI: Responsible = ticket owner, Accountable = Samira, Consulted = SRE/QA, Informed = Eng PMs. If that looks ok, I'll publish in the postmortem doc.
Jared Kim: Sounds good. Linking design doc to RWD-3421 now: https://rwd.atlassian.net/browse/RWD-3421 (attachment + short design note).
Priya Narang: One ask — can we schedule a staging perf run before flipping the cache flag in prod? @Marta SRE
Marta SRE: Yes. I can book a 2hr window next Tue 09:00-11:00 PT for perf + canary. Adding to RWD-3422 and RWD-3423.
Jared Kim: I'll include a post-deploy smoke script. snippet: 
```
kubectl rollout status deploy/cache-proxy -n prod
curl -sSf https://staging.internal/health || exit 1
```
Priya Narang: Perfect. Also adding acceptance criteria to RWD-3422 so QA knows when to verify.
incident-bot: Reminder: Postmortem action item due in 3 days for RWD-3421. Please update status.
Samira Patel: Thanks — let's also add a jira label `remediation:in-progress` and a custom field `remediation-owner` for quick queries. I'll create the field if we agree.
Jared Kim: Added the label and linked subtasks.
Priya Narang: If anyone needs extra time ping me and I'll escalate.
Samira Patel: OK — next check-in scheduled 2026-03-26 17:00 UTC (10:00 PT). I'll update the postmortem doc with confirmed owners, RACI, and timelines. :calendar: :white_check_mark:
Marta SRE: Noted. I'll prep the ops playbook and handoff notes for oncall (runbook + rollback commands).
Samira Patel: Awesome—closing this thread for now; reopen if ownership changes.
